# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Eight years old  <sub>[v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c13 P0](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired child with long, sleek curls that are always kept perfectly neat. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, plump fingers, and a mouth set in a 'prunes and prisms' expression. She routinely appears neat, crisp, and properly dressed, such as wearing an immaculate starched white dress accented by a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c26 P32](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0032)_

## Personality

Lucy is an exceptionally well-behaved, calm, decorous, and rigid young girl. She is tidy, hard-working, dependable, and systematic in her habits. Possessing an unvarying and unemotional temperament, she remains undisturbed by events that upset others. In formal company, she behaves modestly and quietly.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

## History

Lucy was born a twin to her brother Robin. Following the death of her mother when Lucy was six years old, she and Robin were taken in by Thirza Abernethy to reside at Grey Shutters. At Grey Shutters, she diligently assisted with household errands, such as feeding chickens, gathering chips, and drying dishes, and faithfully memorized her weekly religious lessons. She and Robin were given a small plot of land for a garden, where Lucy carefully cultivated organized rows of plants. Later, news arrived that her late uncle Richard Farrow had left a sum of two thousand dollars in trust for her and Robin, securing Grey Shutters as their permanent home. During a severe storm that terrified others, Lucy remained silent and calm while holding hands with Nell Harcourt. On one occasion, she tumbled down the cellar stairs and scraped her nose, but she recovered quickly.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v3 c1 P33](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0033)_
